question: Should `submitText` become the permanent channel-neutral plugin-interaction result, with supporting channels consuming it and unsupported channels ignoring it?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible, but selecting the long-term public plugin SDK abstraction and cross-channel semantics requires repository-owner intent rather than code-review inference.

options.title: Approve shared result
options.body: Adopt the optional shared field after live Discord proof and keep channel-specific authorization and routing enforcement inside each supporting plugin.

options.title: Keep channel-specific results
options.body: Retain Telegram's existing result and introduce Discord-specific typing until a broader interactive-action capability contract is designed.

options.title: Pause for capability design
options.body: Defer this PR and design an explicit channel capability or typed action result before exposing another permanent SDK field.

recommendation.title: Approve shared result
recommendation.body: Adopt the optional shared field after live Discord proof and keep channel-specific authorization and routing enforcement inside each supporting plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the shared public plugin type surface rather than only Discord component implementation.
